clos.loDetails: Describe the definition, concepts and themes of tourism geography
Classify and identify the locations and general characteristics/features of different regions of the world and Vietnam.
Summarize and interpret the multi tourism resources and main tourism products offered of different regions and destinations.
Remember and describe main attractions of all kinds of different countries or provinces
Create and explain appropriate tourism routes of regions and countries.
Evaluate the tourism development potentials of each region and country.
Know how to read, research and collect information from textbooks and other sources
Show a professional attitude in studying the subjects and applying it in reality
Have ability to work in a team and individually, to control time and issues

assessments.gradingGuide:
OP1: Class is divided into 4-5 groups.

The plan of the fieldtrip will be built by class and submitted to teacher for approval before travelling.

The video is made as a result of the fieldtrip.

Each group will be required to do a task in the trip and recording the task they implement. The details requirements are as follow:

1. The video record should show the title: "Field trip for Tourism Geography subject".

2. The video should have university's logo and students should wear school's uniform (if possible).

3. The video should declare the names of group's members.

4. Each group can record the backstage sceneries for enriching the content of the video.

5. Topics will be chosen randomly and assign for students by teachers. Topics suggested are:

- Introduce overview (general) information about the chosen site (i.e. history of establishment, natural/cultural tourism resources, features of the destination's attraction, suitable tourism products).

- Introduce clearly about tourism infrastructure and superstructure of the site (i.e: accommodation, food and beverage, entertainment and recreational activities, etc.).

- Introduce about tourism route to travel to the site, means of transportation used to visit the site and the stopover(s) during the route of travelling.

- Travel tips and note for tourists when visiting the site (time, season, climate, what to bring, how to deal with locals, what to try in the site)

- Identify problems/issues of the site and give recommendation to improve the situation (from your own thought of the site).

An additional written report is submitted together with the video that clearly explain what you've done in the video as requested in each group (it will work as the subtitle for the video).

On the day of the presentation, each group will spend time answering questions from lecturers and other groups about his field trip

OP2: (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal
